impact: Removes the leadership overhang that drove the AI selloff since Nov 12. Direct positive for NBIS (up 30%+) and the GPU supply chain feeding MU, DRAM and SNXX memory demand, and for GOOGL/MSFT AI capex sentiment. Huang still faces House testimony on Dec 1-2.
summary: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director on Monday, per an SEC 8-K, after input from senior US officials who found no national security risk. Colette Kress returns to CFO and Harvey Jones stays chair. Trump said he played a decisive role in convincing the board. NVDA closed about 30% higher, its best day since 2003, adding roughly $952B in market value. Neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius rose more than 30%, AMD about 6% and Broadcom about 3%.
title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; NVDA closes up about 30%, Nebius and CoreWeave up 30%+
